description:
Planning only: start implementation only after the Mattermost prerequisite gate passes and implementation is authorized. Read parent epic and linked Page. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, action-reuse.md, documentation.md, testing-approach.md and services/channels.md. Read affected service/config/UI policies before work. Recheck module docs, source and existing tests; test scenarios below are specified before implementation. Obtain required approval for changes to existing test behavior; prior UX approval does not cover the new SMTP inputs. Reuse fixtures and internal production boundaries, mock external provider edges only. No automatic application commit/push/merge authorization.

Source mapping: Page Task 6 Integrate Channels API and Jido bridge.

**Files:** `lib/zaq/channels/api.ex`, `lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex`, `lib/zaq/channels/bridge.ex`. Dependency pins were adopted and verified in Task 1.

**Work:** retain API connection/identity resolution, route every communication outgoing through DeliveryFiles, dispatch unchanged outgoing messages with no plan to the existing bridge send_reply path, and dispatch planned outcomes to the shared executor, implement normalized Jido bridge operations, and remove policy forwarding/splitting from the migrated path. Retain generic text send/update, :validate_files, capability reporting, and safe errors. Move Channel-side selection-error handling into DeliveryFiles instead of maintaining an API bypass; leave Agent production of attachment_error unchanged. For direct attachment-bearing bridge callers, reuse shared preparation/execution or a clearly internal prepared-operation boundary. Keep the no-plan text send as the existing implementation; it must not re-enter API planning. Avoid duplicate preparation and recursive send_reply calls.

**Tests:** extend `test/zaq/channels/api_test.exs`, `jido_chat_delivery_test.exs`, `jido_chat_bridge/delivery_result_test.exs`, and `disk_file_delivery_integration_test.exs`. Reuse `test/support/mattermost_history_fixture.ex` and `channel_file_delivery.ex`.

**Paths:** existing streamed message, send then attach, create with uploaded IDs, multiple groups, true native attachment edits versus text edits only, selected connector limits, public payload sanitization, thread root precedence, callbacks once, Agent selection preflight unchanged.

**Reuse:** extend existing :deliver_outgoing dispatch and bridge send/edit helpers. Reuse Jido post/response normalization where compatible; no bypass of its message identity/state bookkeeping. NotifyPerson and workflow notification paths remain consumers of existing Engine/Channel dispatch, not duplicated send implementations.

**Docs:** bridge module docs, channels guide, and dependency compatibility notes.

Resolve host compatibility failures handed off by work-pim.6, without restoring provider orchestration. No second dependency pin issue.

Reuse/verification: use the existing owner and tests named above; no parallel transport pipeline, new history store, automatic Action/tool exposure or Agent-selection changes. Scope any new scheduler unit suite to genuinely distinct invariants.
title: [zaq-1lw.6] Integrate Channels API and Jido bridge with planned operations
